name: Gilbert Creek Woodworks
old_description: With decades of experience in the industry and proven methods, Gilbert Creek Woodworks is a premier provider of custom wood products, including kitchen cabinets, office furniture, entertainment centers, architectural millwork, and other specialty wood pieces. We make beautiful wood products that significantly enhance lives through exceptional communication, design, and manufacturing.
about:
Gilbert Creek Woodworks was founded in 1987 by Duane Zweber in Menomonie, Wisconsin. After 30 years as a production manager and head of product design for two large woodworking firms, Zweber established his own shop to produce custom wood products. The business remains family-run, with his sons Brian and Robert now involved in finishing and operations.

The company designs, manufactures, and finishes a range of custom woodwork, including kitchen cabinets, office furniture, entertainment centers, and architectural millwork. All production is handled in-house, from initial design through final finishing, allowing the team to control quality on each piece.

Gilbert Creek serves both residential and commercial clients, producing pieces for individual homeowners as well as businesses seeking custom office environments. Duane Zweber’s background includes projects for individuals and companies around the world, and the company’s website highlights work for homes, businesses, and special projects.

The firm emphasizes communication, design, and manufacturing as its core differentiators, describing its approach as a “better way of building things.” Brian Zweber’s specialized training at the National Institute of Wood Finishing adds expertise in finish trends and creative finishing solutions.
